name: Bluetooth Headphones
author: Flubsound
description: For Bluetooth (A2DP) headphones and earbuds. The ceiling is -2 dBTP because lossy codecs (SBC, AAC, aptX, LDAC) overshoot peaks, the clipper is kept soft and the air exciter low so the codec is not fed extra high-frequency distortion, and bass is centred below 120 Hz for efficient joint-stereo coding. Bluetooth itself adds 100-300 ms latency.
